name: PlayerHUD Flyer
description: Educational flyer about the PlayerHUD plugin: what it is, features, how to set it up, the student journey and a comparison.

config.contentHtml:
What is PlayerHUD?

PlayerHUD is a gamification plugin for Moodle that turns the learning experience into a journey of progress. Students earn Experience Points (XP) by completing activities, rise through levels, win badges, unlock drops and compete on the overall ranking — all inside the LMS itself, with no external tools.

items.title: XP System
items.description: Every completed activity grants configurable XP. The teacher sets the weight of each submission.

items.title: Progression Levels
items.description: Students level up as they accumulate XP, unlocking new statuses and rewards.

items.title: Badges and Achievements
items.description: Automatic badges for milestones reached: first submission, access streak, top grade.

items.title: Random Drops
items.description: Surprise rewards for completing activities — items, XP bonuses or unlocked cosmetics.

items.title: Global Ranking
items.description: Leaderboard visible to everyone — encourages healthy competition and continued motivation.

items.title: Settings Panel
items.description: A complete interface for the teacher to manage XP, levels, drops and achievements per course.

config.text: How to Set It Up in 5 Steps

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: Download PlayerHUD from the Moodle Plugin Directory and install it via Site administration → Plugins → Install plugin.

items.title: Set the XP per activity
items.description: In the plugin panel, define how many points each type of activity grants when completed.

items.title: Create the progression levels
items.description: Define the XP thresholds for each level (e.g. Level 1 = 0–99 XP, Level 2 = 100–299 XP…).

items.title: Set up badges and drops
items.description: Create automatic achievements for milestones and enable drops to make every activity a surprise.

items.title: Launch it to the students
items.description: Enable the PlayerHUD block in the course. Students will see their HUD and start accumulating XP right away.

items.title: First access — starting XP
items.description: On first accessing the course, the student earns their first XP and sees the HUD appear with level, progress bar and ranking.

items.title: Level 2 unlocked
items.description: After submitting the first activities, the accumulated XP takes the student to the second level — a notification celebrates the achievement.

items.title: First badge earned
items.description: Active participation in the forum or a top grade in an assessment earns the first badge, shown on everyone's profile.

items.title: Top 10 on the ranking
items.description: With consistent submissions, the student enters the leaderboard and inspires the class to excel.

items.title: Mission accomplished!
items.description: All activities completed, maximum XP reached and achievements unlocked. The student ends the journey as a champion.

config.contentHtml:
Start gamifying now!

Install PlayerHUD for free from the Moodle Plugin Directory and turn your course into a journey of progress that students will not want to stop.
